scheduleFile.note: Raw .xlsx on Drive (view-only) -- read via Drive files.get(alt=media) + the xlsx package, not the Sheets API. Same file scripts/attendance uses.

calendar.note: The user's existing 'Term I Schedule' calendar -- already has ~60 manually-created events on it in a fixed convention (see lib/calendarEvents.mjs), which this sync adopts/tags rather than duplicating.

sync.note: Syncs every intervalMinutes, but only within activeHours (in timeZone above) -- outside that window, install-launchd.sh doesn't even schedule a wakeup, so nothing runs at all, not just a no-op check-in. A manually-run --force sync ignores both the interval and the active-hours window.

notifications.note: One summary email per sync run, only when something actually changed (created/updated/deleted > 0) -- never one email per event. Sent via Gmail API as the same account (gmail.send scope), so fromEmail must match the authenticated account.
